AGENDA ITEMS AND ACTIONS
5:45 P.M. CLOSED SESSION

CALL TO ORDER Mayor Rebollo called Concurrent Special meeting to order at 5:24 p.m. via teleconferencing.

ROLL CALL

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEMS There were no individuals wishing to address the City Council on any items on the Closed Session agenda.  

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION City Council recessed to Closed Session at 5:27 p.m.

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION City Council reconvened to Open Session at 6:08 p.m.

ORAL CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT City Attorney Tapia reported on item #1 and stated that staff made a presentation, City Council provided feedback and no reportable action was taken on this item.  

ADJOURNMENT Meeting adjourned at 6:08 p.m.

Written materials distributed to the City Council are available for public inspection immediately following the posting of this agenda (at least 72 hours prior to a regular City Council meetings) in the City Clerk's Office, at Commerce City Hall, 2535 Commerce Way, Commerce, California, and the Central Library, 5655 Jillson Street, Commerce, California.

If requested, the agenda and backup materials will be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability, as required by Section 202 of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (42 U.S.C. Sec. 12132), and the federal rules and regulations adopted in implementation thereof.  Any person who requires a disability-related modification or accommodation, in order to observe and/or offer public comment may request such reasonable modification, accommodation, aid, or service by contacting via email to cityclerk@ci.commerce.ca.us or by telephone at 323-722-4805 no later than 9 AM on the day of the scheduled meeting.


To protect public health, this meeting is being held in accordance with AB 361, Government Code section 54954(e)(1) (A). Given the proclaimed state of emergency and the Los Angeles County Health Department recommendation for social distancing for public meetings, which is also consistent with Cal OSHA requirements for social distancing, the City will be conducting public meeting via video/teleconferencing and there will be no physical location available for this meeting.   To participate in the City of Commerce ‘public meetings and provide public comment during the COVID-19 public health emergency, please follow these steps:

1.	Watch or Listen: Meetings are broadcast/streamed live on the City of Commerce’s Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/City-of-Commerce-123903054365151/?ref. Archived, on-demand video of each meeting is maintained on the City’s Facebook as part of the public record.

2.	Submit Comments before the Meeting: Members of the public can provide public comment by sending an e-mail to cityclerk@ci.commerce.ca.us for City Council meetings, and the comment will be read during Public Comment portion.  

3.	Live Remote Public Comments: Members of the public may submit live public comment via Zoom conferencing by using the link below. You must download the Zoom app or software. Zoom meetings can be accessed by telephone, computer, or smart device.  You will be allowed to speak during Public Comment portion of the agenda.  

4.	At the time and date of the meeting, please click this URL to join the Zoom meeting: 

https://us06web.zoom.us/j/89327661167?pwd=RTRCM3FVeklwUHVjcTZlVHpoMkI4Zz09

Passcode: 190111 or join by phone: Dial 1(720) 707-2699; Meeting ID: 893 2766 1167
